descriptionText: Dependabot should have appropriate cooldown periods configured to prevent excessive update pull requests. The cooldown setting limits how frequently Dependabot creates pull requests for a given dependency, reducing noise and CI/CD load. Without a cooldown or with an insufficient cooldown period (less than 7 days recommended), Dependabot may create too many pull requests, overwhelming maintainers and consuming CI/CD resources. The default-days setting in the cooldown configuration should be set to at least 7 days. Note: If default-days is not set, Dependabot treats it as 0, which means no cooldown by default. This rule applies to .github/dependabot.yml configuration files.
